description: The Hurricane Electric BGP Toolkit is a free web service run by the network operator Hurricane Electric that reports how networks and prefixes appear in the global internet routing table. Its menu offers a prefix report, a peer report, an exchange report of internet exchange points, bogon routes, a world report by country, multi-origin routes, a DNS report, a top host report, an RPKI and ASPA report, internet statistics, a looking glass, super traceroute and certificate search. Coverage: global, from Hurricane Electric's view of BGP; the home page showed an update time of 28 September 2026. Format and access: interactive HTML pages per autonomous system, prefix, exchange and country; free, without sign-in. Licence: not stated on the page read; terms of use were not read. Caveats: the toolkit is a browsing tool, not a bulk data service, and it reflects one operator's vantage points; automated scraping may be limited. Simulation uses: looking up autonomous system neighbours, prefixes and exchange memberships to build or check internet topology models for cascading failure and resilience studies. Related records: PeeringDB (data-peeringdb) holds the self-reported interconnection data, and CAIDA AS Relationships (data-caida-as-relationships) gives inferred links in bulk.
